[[File:Iron scimitar detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''iron scimitar''' is a [[melee weapon]] that can be used in [[combat]]. It is stronger than the [[bronze scimitar]]. Players can make an iron scimitar with 20 [[Smithing]] using 2 [[iron bar]]s, giving 50 [[experience]].
